targetText: Norway "achieved" the supposedly unachievable right to self-determination in 1905, in the era of the most rampant imperialism. It is therefore not only absurd, but ludicrous, from the theoretical standpoint, to speak of "unachievability".
summary: Lenin points to Norway's peaceful 1905 secession from Sweden to empirically prove against dogmatists that sovereign statehood and political self-determination can indeed be achieved under modern imperialism.
context: In 1905, Norway dissolved its dynastic union with Sweden through a popular referendum, demonstrating that political borders could change without overturning the capitalist economy.
